During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], an invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the invaders '''attacked''' the [[Edusa system/Legends|Edusa system]]. The offensive took place between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], and was the follow up to an [[Attack on the Vandyne system|attack]] on the [[Vandyne system/Legends|Vandyne system]] after which the Yuuzhan Vong traveled along a [[Axxila–Tangrene hyperlane/Legends|hyperlane]] to reach the Edusa [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Following the strike on the Edusa system, the Yuuzhan Vong moved on along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to [[Attack on the Tangrene system|attack]] the [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Edusa system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Atlas included the attack in a map titled "Vector Prime and the Yuuzhan Vong advance" which showed the movements and conflicts of the various factions involved in the Yuuzhan Vong War, between 25 ABY and 26 ABY. The book gives no information on the outcome of the attack, but a separate map shows the Edusa system was under Yuuzhan Vong control by 26 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />
